details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> tests: fix CI flakes of TOPK_MOE caused by near ties (#31426) * tests: fix CI flakes of TOPK_MOE caused by near ties With uniform random logits, two experts sometimes land within one f32 ulp of each other at a routing boundary, mostly with sqrt_softplus gating whose output range is narrow. A backend whose gating differs by a few ulps from the CPU then picks the other expert and the test fails. Draw each row of logits again until the group selection and the final top-k both have a relative margin of 1e-4, computed on the host in double precision. * tests: build the TOPK_MOE logits by inverting the gating function Draw the selection scores (probs plus bias) of each row as a random permutation of a grid, move the experts of the best groups up by half a step, and set the logits to the inverse of the gating function at these scores. A fit result that offloads all layers then leaves layer 0 on the CPU ("offloaded 65/66 layers" for Qwen3.8-27B on two GPUs). Add the skipped NextN layers to n_gpu_layers and to the tensor split of the device that holds the output layer so the loader assigns the layers that fit measured. details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> vulkan: FWHT kernels for block widths above 512 (#29772) * vulkan: add F16 input to the FWHT The Vulkan FWHT accepts F32 input only. This adds an F16 source variant of the shader, for both the subgroup and the shared-memory paths, so the kernel reads an F16 source directly instead of requiring a converted copy. The F16 shader needs shader-float16, so the pipelines are only created when the device reports it. A null pipeline makes ggml_vk_can_use_fwht fall back, which is the same path an unsupported width already takes. supports_op and the dispatch both already route through ggml_vk_can_use_fwht, so there is a single place asking whether an op qualifies; nothing to consolidate here the way the CUDA/Metal ports needed. test-backend-ops on an M5 Pro (MoltenVK, fp16: 1): MUL_MAT 1128/1128, including all 24 Hadamard cases (18 existing F32, 6 new F16).
